what: Wren's lantern-oil gauge (max 4 oil). Sits in Wren's mana-bar slot of the party panel.
placementNote: Own row under Wren's mana bar (mana stays at y437). Because hand buttons used to start at y442, shift ALL eight hand buttons down 5 px to y447 (31x28 unchanged, now ending at y475; nothing else sits there before y508). Segment canvasOffsets below are relative to x70; add y442+1.
frameCold: oil_gauge_frame_cold.png (used inside the ember look; not needed separately)

segments.rule: draw frame, then for unit i (0..3) draw seg_full if i < oil else seg_empty at offsets[i] (relative to the frame)

oil0.note: At 0 oil replace the whole gauge with the ember look (cold frame, empty slots, blue-white ember at the left). Matches wren_lantern_ember portrait + hand_prayer_lantern_ember.

compositesNote: oil_gauge_N.png = ready-made gauge for N oil (0 = ember frame 1). Use these if simpler than assembling pieces.
flash: optional: on +1 oil, flash the new segment 2 ticks white (code tint); on relight -1, blink the lost segment
open: This replaces Wren's blue mana bar in that slot. If Wren keeps a mana bar too, the panel needs another 4 px row; tell Pixelartie and I'll re-cut it.
